title: Miscellaneous
summary: MISCELLA'NEOUS, adjective [Latin miscellaneus, from misceo, to mix.] Mixed; mingled; consisting of several kinds; as a miscellaneous publication; a miscellaneous rabble.

inlines.v: MISCELLA'NEOUS, adjective [Latin miscellaneus, from misceo, to mix.] Mixed; mingled; consisting of several kinds; as a miscellaneous publication; a miscellaneous rabble.
